## ElevenLabs TTS v4 API

ElevenLabs TTS v4 is a text-to-speech model by ElevenLabs, available on the Venice API as `elevenlabs-tts-v4`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Generate expressive text-to-speech audio using ElevenLabs Eleven-v4. High-quality voices with audio tag support and automatic text normalization.

### ElevenLabs TTS v4 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elevenlabs-tts-v4` | Standard | Anonymized | $92.00 / 1M chars |

### ElevenLabs TTS v4 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | ElevenLabs |
| Released | Sep 29, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Voices | 20 |
| Formats | mp3 |

### How to use the ElevenLabs TTS v4 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue` with `"model": "elevenlabs-tts-v4"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "elevenlabs-tts-v4",
    "prompt": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'

# 2. Retrieve when ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "elevenlabs-tts-v4", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output audio.mp3
```
